senses.gloss: a. Ved. Not to be unloosened; सिनात्वेनान्निरृतिर्मृत्योः पाशैरमोक्यैः [[Av. 3. 6. 5.]]
Not loosening or letting go, non-liberation.

अमोचनीय,
 
-अमोच्य a. Not to be liberated; अमोच्यमश्वं यदि मन्यसे प्रभो [[R. 3. 65.]]

a. Not liberated, unloosed. 
-क्षः 
__1 Bondage, confinement. 
__2 Non-liberation from worldly existence.

a. 
__1 Unfailing, reaching the mark; धनुष्यमोघं समधत्त बाणम् [[Ku. 3. 66]]; [[R. 3. 53]]; 12. 97; कामिलक्ष्येष्वमोघैः [[Me. 75.]] 
__2 Unerring, infallible (words, boon &c.); अमोघाः प्रतिगृह्णन्तावर्घ्यानुपदमाशिषः [[R. 1. 44]]; युतममोघतया [[Ki. 6. 40.]] 
__3 Not vain or useless, efficacious, fruitful, productive; यदमोघमपामन्तरुप्तं बीजमज त्वया [[Ku. 2. 5]]; so °बलम्, °शक्ति, °वीर्य, °क्रोध &c. 
-घः 
__1 Not failing or erring, unerringness. 
__2 N. of Viṣṇu (or of Śiva according to some). 
__3 N. of a river. 
-घा 
__1 N. of the plant पाटली (Mar. पाडळी) (the trumpet flower). 
__2 N. of another plant विडङ्ग (Mar. वावडिंग) the seed of which is used as a vermifuge, and hence also called कृमिघ्न. 
__3 = पथ्या. 
__4 N. of a spear or शक्ति. 
__5 N. of Śiva's wife. 
__6 Mystical name of the conjunct consonant क्ष. 
-Comp. 
-अक्षी f. N. of Dākṣāyaṇī, [[Matsya P.]] 
-दण्डः unerring in punishment, N. of Śiva. 
-दर्शिन्, -दृष्टि a. of unerring mind or view, N. of a Bodhisattva. 
-नन्दिनी N. of a Śikṣā-text. 
-पाशः N. of a Lokeśvara (Buddhistic). 
-बल a. of never-failing strength or vigour. (उच्चैःश्रवस्). 
-भूतिः N. of a king of the Punjab. 
-राजः N. of a Bhikṣu; [[L. V.]] 
-वर्षः N. of a Chālukya prince. 
-वाच् f. words not vain or idle, that are sure to be fulfilled or realized. a. one whose words are not vain. 
-वाञ्छित a. never disappointed. 
-विक्रमः of neverfailing valour; N. of Siva. 
-सिद्धिः N. of the fifth Dhyānibuddha.
a. [अमा-उत] Ved. The hems or skirts of which are not cut; woven at home, taken care of or protected at home; °पुत्रका a maiden protected at home. cf. [[Av. 20. 127. 5.]]

__1 One protected at home (as a child). 
__2 A weaver (?).

आमोक्षणम्,
 
-आमोचनम् 
__1 Loosening, liberating. 
__2 Emitting, shedding, letting forth, discharging. 
__3 Putting or tying on; केयूरामोक्षणस्य च [[Rām. 2. 24. 38.]]
An ending verse containing the poet's name (यत्रैव कबिनाम स्यात् स आमोग इतीरितः इति संगीतदामोदरः)

a. Gladdening, cheering up, delighting. 
-दः 
__1 Joy, pleasure, delight; आमोदं परमं जग्मुः [[Rām.]] 
__2 Fragrance (diffusive), perfume; आमोदमुपजिघ्नन्तौ स्वनिःश्वासानुकारिणम् [[R. 1. 43]]; आमोदं कुसुमभवं मृदेव धत्ते मृद्गन्धं न हि कुमुमानि धारयन्ति [[Subhāṣ.]]; आमोदकर्मव्यतिहारमीयुः [[Śi. 2. 20]]; [[Me. 31.]] 
__3 Strong smell; आमोदो न हि कस्तूर्याः शपथेन प्रकाश्यते [[Subhāṣ.]] 
-Comp. 
-जननी 'causing a strong smell', betel.

a. Delighting, pleasing. 
-नम् 
__1 Delighting, rejoicing; अभुञ्जतामोदनमोदनं जनाः [[N.]] 
__2 Making fragrant.

p. p. 
__1 Pleased, delighted. 
__2 Made fragrant, scented.

a. 
__1 Happy, delighted. 
__2 Fragrant; fragrant or perfumed with; oft. at the end of comp.; नबकुटजकदम्बामोदिनो गन्धवाहाः [[Bh. 1. 35.]] m. 
(-दी) A perfume for the mouth (made in the form of a pill of camphor &c.).
A seed of the Dill kind, Lingusticum Ajwaen (Mar. ओंवा).
